description: This file defines the CustomerOptionEntity class, which extends CustomerOption and implements Serializable. It adds properties such as order, code, and type related to customer options in an e-commerce application.

classes.name: CustomerOptionEntity
classes.description: A serializable entity class extending CustomerOption that adds additional attributes for customer options.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Sets the order position of the customer option.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the order position of the customer option.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code identifier for the customer option.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the code identifier for the customer option.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Retrieves the type of the customer option (e.g., TEXT, SELECT, RADIO, CHECKBOX).

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the customer option.
